description:
Stop `test_check_gate_records_its_run_evidence_with_the_issue_verdict_it_explains` depending on the git state of the directory it runs in.

## Background

`enforce_main_only_operations` reads the repository of the process's working directory. The test failed in a clone whose `origin/main` had moved ahead of its checkout, and `cli_gate` passed 139/139 once that remote was removed. `@/inv/orthogonal-tests` requires a test to build the state it reads in storage it owns.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workspace suite passes whatever the git state of the checkout that runs it, with the evidence of a run from a checkout whose `origin/main` is ahead.
- [hard] REQ-02: `enforce_main_only_operations`, `check_branch_divergence` and `validate_branch_drift` act on the repository they serve, and so does any other production git spawn in `commands/` found reading the process's cwd instead. A target repository without git still skips the guard (`@/charter/D-4`).
- [hard] REQ-03: One test over repositories it owns, with no cwd change, proves the wrong-refusal and bypass cases and that `validate_branch_drift` follows the same repository.



## Evidence

At `b27d75188`, on a base of `fbb99eb7c`, from a clone whose `origin/main` is ahead: the whole workspace passes `cargo nextest run` 4649/4649 and doctests 25/25.

13 production git spawns in `commands/`: 5 read the cwd and are fixed (`worktree.rs` 3, `validate.rs` 2), and 8 already pass an explicit root. Of those 8, `claim.rs` (3) and `init.rs` (1) use the layout's worktree root, which is the invocation's directory for a store outside git under `JIT_DATA_DIR`. `validate --branch-drift` without git reports an error rather than skipping, since it is an explicit check rather than a guard.
title: Git guards act on the repository they serve, not the process's cwd
